question: What are the core values of the University of Embu?
expected_answer: Integrity, Professionalism, Team work, Innovativeness, Customer focus

expected_answer: More than seven days requires written permission from the Dean of Students; two continuous weeks absent without permission means forfeiting residence

question: When must graduation forms be submitted?
expected_answer: At least four weeks before the graduation date, to the Registrar (ARE) through the department and School

question: What must I carry to an exam room?
expected_answer: The Examination Card and the student ID, both displayed on the desk throughout

question: Does the university allow credit transfer or credit waiver?
expected_answer: Yes. Fill in the application form available at the Office of the Registrar (ARE) and submit it for processing

question: when will a student be discontinued on academic grounds
expected_answer: Failing more than 75% of the units taken in an academic year (under both supplementary and retake systems); also failing retakes after two attempts and a repeated year

question: How long do I have to appeal a disciplinary committee decision?
expected_answer: In writing to the Vice-Chancellor within 14 days of the date the decision is communicated

question: What is the pass mark for masters and taught doctorate programmes?

expected_answer: 2 years; C- at KCSE or equivalent, or D+ with a relevant certificate

question: What should I do if I miss a CAT because I was sick?
expected_answer: Report to the lecturer, the Chairman of Department and the Dean of Students; a make-up CAT is given before the end of semester exams
